runSummary.note: Real 17 Sep 03:52 sweep. Eleven independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, and public Facebook indexing. No promotion-grade new job was found. Upwork surfaced a WordPress/WooCommerce technical expert role posted yesterday, but it already has 50+ proposals and requires server-side performance, PHP/MySQL, caching/CDN and security expertise beyond the preferred profile. A worldwide WooCommerce product-listing role at $10-30/h remains functionally strong but is three weeks old, already hired once and has four active interviews. Top4Mobile e-shop administrator remains explicitly closed. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Client last-viewed decay
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: For marketplace jobs, sharply reduce priority when the client has not viewed the listing for several days or weeks. Combine last-viewed age with interviews and hires so apparently open but abandoned jobs stop consuming application time.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Task-scope skill ceiling
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Separate a familiar platform label such as WordPress/WooCommerce from the actual technical ceiling of the task. Detect server/PHP/MySQL/CDN/security requirements and cap fit automatically when the assignment crosses from administration/troubleshooting into specialist hard development or infrastructure.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
